title: Hardness of approximation for minimum-weight decoding of two-dimensional topological quantum codes
summary: Efficient decoding is essential for the practical realization of fault-tolerant quantum computers. We study the computational complexity of minimum-weight decoding for topological quantum codes. For surface codes under the depolarizing channel, we consider Minimum-Weight decoding, which seeks a minimum-weight Pauli error consistent with both the $X$- and $Z$-syndromes. For color codes under independent $X$- and $Z$-error models, we consider Separate Minimum-Weight decoding.
